description: Closed molecular system for independent computational investigation of aqueous basicity of two PyDIG geometric isomers.

molecules.label: E,E-PyDIG neutral base
molecules.stereochemistry: E,E at both pyridylmethylene C=N bonds

molecules.label: Z,Z-PyDIG neutral base
molecules.stereochemistry: Z,Z at both pyridylmethylene C=N bonds

molecules.label: E,E-PyDIG singly protonated conjugate acid
molecules.protonation: one added proton on central guanidine imine nitrogen

molecules.label: Z,Z-PyDIG singly protonated conjugate acid
molecules.protonation: one added proton on central guanidine imine nitrogen

endpoint: aqueous thermodynamic pKa for each geometric isomer and their difference
